description: inspect schema takes --anchor like vet schema: the schema's own $root/*.kdl import expands against --anchor root=parts, so the import item is followed by each matched document in portable-path-byte order, parts/a.kdl (source 1, contributing the Extra type) then parts/b.kdl (source 2, contributing the extra node), each shown relative to the importer, before the importing document's remaining items; the inputs are this scenario's own copies of schemas/vet/import-anchor
